research_brief.object: A first hypothetical singularity of a smooth 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes solution
research_brief.central_claim: A uniform pressure-safe decay of a critical local envelope would rule out the singularity through epsilon regularity.
alternative_explanations: The compact limit does not satisfy the planned Liouville theorem hypotheses.
research_brief.falsification: Produce an admissible normalized sequence violating the decay inequality or identify an unabsorbable term.

formal_objects.equation: partial_t u + (u dot grad)u + grad p = nu Delta u; div u = 0
formal_objects.scaling: u_lambda(x,t) = lambda u(lambda x, lambda^2 t)
formal_objects.target: E(theta r,z) <= q E(r,z) + K Tail(r,z), with 0<q<1 uniformly

proof_obligations.description: Formulation, scaling, and local continuation framework
